y-m-37-01.title: Duba mafitar da ta gano sharadin tushen ainihi
y-m-37-01.topic: Sharadin tushen ainihi ga ma’auni mai ƙididdiga harafi: zaton cewa ma’aunin digiri biyu ne
y-m-37-01.goal: Fahimci cewa a ma’auni mai harafi a cikin coefficient, irin furuci na iya canzawa bisa ƙimar harafin, sannan ka daidaita iyakar ƙarshe da sharadin bayanin matsalar.
y-m-37-01.material: Minjae ya warware wannan matsala: “Nemo iyakar k da za ta sa ma’aunin digiri biyu kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (k lamba ce ta ainihi) ya sami tushen ainihi.” (Karatu: k ninka x murabba’i, a rage 4x, a ƙara 1, daidai da 0.) Tushen ainihi na nufin tushen lamba ce ta ainihi. Duba warwarewar Minjae layi bayan layi.
y-m-37-01.thinking.0: Nemo zato da ya ɓace a warwarewar.
y-m-37-01.thinking.1: Yi hukunci yadda amsa ke canzawa idan sharadin matsalar ya canza.
y-m-37-01.thinking.2: Nemo yanayin iyaka da kanka ka tabbatar.
y-m-37-01.prereq.0: H3 yana nufin rarrabuwar wahala a matakin samarwa kawai, ba warewar wannan abun ciki ga wani aji ba. A ɗauka ɗalibi ya riga ya koyi abubuwan da aka ambata.
y-m-37-01.prereq.1: Dangantakar discriminant na ma’aunin digiri biyu da yawan tushen ainihi
y-m-37-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya da zai sa ƙarshe Minjae ya zama abin shakka. Sake karanta matsalar, ka bincika layi ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo kalmomin farko na matsala da suka bayyana irin ma’aunin, ka duba ko ƙarshe ya yi la’akari da duk ƙimar k da suka cika wannan sharadi.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi mafi sauƙin lamba cikakkiya daga cikin ƙimar k da aka haɗa cikin ƙarshe, saka ta cikin furucin, ka faɗi irin furucin da ya zama.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.0: Domin ma’aunin digiri biyu kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ya sami tushen ainihi, dole discriminant ya cika D ≥ 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka iyakar k da ake nema ita ce k ≤ 4.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.explain: Matsalar ta ce kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ma’aunin digiri biyu ne. Domin ya zama ma’aunin digiri biyu, coefficient k na x² ba zai zama 0 ba. Layi na 1 ya fara amfani da discriminant ba tare da duba wannan sharadi ba, kuma ƙarshe k ≤ 4 na layi na 4 ya haɗa k = 0. Lissafin layuka na 2 da 3 daidai ne. Amsar daidai ita ce k ≤ 4 kuma k ≠ 0. Ko ka zaɓi layi na 1 ko na 4, muhimmin batu yana nan guda.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.prompt: Idan aka cire kalmar ma’aunin digiri biyu daga matsalar, aka tambayi iyakar k da za ta sa ma’aunin kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ya sami tushen ainihi, menene amsar?
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.0: Saka k = 0 da k = 4 cikin furucin, ka nemo mafita da kanka.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.1: Yi alama ko kowace zaɓi tana yarda da k = 0 ko a’a, ka kwatanta da mafitar da ka samu da kanka.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.a: k < 4. Idan discriminant 0 ne, akwai tushe ninki biyu, saboda haka ba a haɗa shi.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.a: Idan D = 0, akwai tushe ainihi guda, tushe ninki biyu. Maganar “yana da tushe ainihi” ta haɗa da tushe ninki biyu.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.b: k ≤ 4 kuma k ≠ 0. Idan k = 0, ba furuci mai digiri biyu ba ne, saboda haka babu mafita.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.b: Idan k = 0, ma’aunin ya zama −4x + 1 = 0 kuma yana da tushen ainihi x = 1/4. Rashin zama furuci mai digiri biyu ba yana nufin babu mafita ba.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.c: k ≤ 4. Akwai tushen ainihi idan k = 0 ma.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.d: k ≥ 4. Zaɓi gefen da discriminant yake 0 ko fiye.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.d: Ka sake duba alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito yayin warware D = 16 − 4k ≥ 0 dangane da k. Misali, saka k = 0 da k = 5 ka kwatanta ko da gaske akwai tushen gaske.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.explain: Idan an ce “ma’auni” kawai, k = 0 ma ƙima ce da aka yarda da ita. Idan k = 0, to −4x + 1 = 0 kuma akwai tushen gaske x = 1/4, saboda haka kewayon k shi ne k ≤ 4 (har da 0). Ko mafita ɗaya ce, ƙarshen na iya bambanta bisa sharadin da aka faɗa a tambaya (ko ma’aunin murabba’i ne ko a’a).
y-m-37-01.s.s3.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin k biyu daban-daban da za su sa ma’aunin kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (a wannan karon ba sai ya zama ma’aunin murabba’i ba) ya sami tushe guda ɗaya na gaske daban.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta sharadin samun tushe guda ɗaya na gaske idan ƙididdigar x² ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta furucin yanayin da ƙididdigar x² ta zama 0, sannan ƙirga mafita nawa yake da su.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Ga wannan k, ma’aunin yana da tushe guda ɗaya na gaske tak.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Ga wannan k, ƙirga tushen gaske daban-daban na ma’aunin. Raba yanayi bisa ko ƙididdigar x² ta zama 0 ko a’a.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.explain: Idan k = 4, to 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)², saboda haka x = 1/2 ne kaɗai; idan k = 0, to −4x + 1 = 0, saboda haka x = 1/4 ne kaɗai. k = 4 inda determinant yake 0 bai isa shi kaɗai ba; dole kuma a binciki k = 0 dabam, inda nau’in furuci yake canjawa.

y-m-37-07.title: Shin mafitar da Sua ta samo dukkan mafita ne?
y-m-37-07.topic: Kewayon da ake zaɓar masu yiwuwa yayin nemo mafitar ma’aunin digiri uku, da tushen hukunci
y-m-37-07.goal: Sanin cewa ma’aunin digiri uku mai ƙididdigogi cikakku na iya samun mafita marasa lambobi cikakku, sannan bayyana wa aboki yadda ya dace dalilin da ya sa yawan mafita da ka samo kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da “na samo su duka”.
y-m-37-07.material: Sua ta warware tambayar neman duk mafita na gaske na ma’aunin digiri uku 2x³ − x² − 7x + 6 = 0 (Karanta: 2 x kubu a cire x murabba’i a cire 7x a ƙara 6 daidai yake da 0) kamar haka.
y-m-37-07.thinking.1: Nemo mafitar da ta ɓace sannan ka tabbatar da ita da kanka

y-m-37-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a warwarewar Sua da ke da wuyar yarda. Bincika dabam ko lissafin kowane layi daidai ne da ko dalilinsa daidai ne.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sake lissafa sakamakon sakawa a layi na 2 da 3 da kanka, ka duba ko ƙimomin daidai ne.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.1: A layi na 4, tantance ko “aƙalla 3” da “waɗannan biyun kawai” ma’ana ɗaya suke. Misali, a (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3) = 0, me zai faru idan ka nemo mafita biyu kawai ka tsaya?
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.0: Idan mafita akwai, suna cikin masu raba adadin marar canji 6, wato ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6, saboda haka waɗannan takwas kaɗai muke gwadawa.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.1: x = 1: 2 − 1 − 7 + 6 = 0, saboda haka mafita ce. x = −2: −16 − 4 + 14 + 6 = 0, saboda haka mafita ce.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.2: Sauran masu yiwuwa ±3, ±6, 2, −1 duk ba sa zama 0 idan an saka.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.3: Ma’aunin digiri uku yana da mafita aƙalla 3, kuma mun samo 2, saboda haka mafita su ne x = 1 da x = −2 kawai.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1: idan mafita lamba cikakkiya ce kawai za ta kasance cikin masu raba adadin marar canji. Idan ƙididdigar farko 2 ce, mafita ta gutsure kamar 3/2 ma tana yiwuwa. Layi na 4: “aƙalla 3” na nufin har zuwa 3 za a iya samu, don haka samun 2 ba dalili ba ne na cewa babu wasu. Lissafin layi na 2 da 3 daidai ne.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.prompt: Nemo mafita ta uku ta gaske da Sua ta rasa, shigar da ita a matsayin adadin goma. (Rubuta ta a matsayin adadin goma, misali 0.5.)
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ƙuntatawar da sanin mafita x = 1 da x = −2 ya dora kan sifar furucin digiri uku.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta wannan ƙuntatawa, nemo furuci mai sauƙi da ya rage, sannan saka x da ke sa furucin ya zama 0 cikin ma’aunin asali don tabbatarwa.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Idan ka saka wannan ƙima, furucin ya zama 0.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Saka ƙimar da ka shigar cikin furucin, ka ƙididdige da kanka ko ya zama 0.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ba mafita ce da Sua ta riga ta samo ba.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne ka nemo ƙima wadda ba ɗaya daga mafitar da Sua ta riga ta samu ba (1 da −2).
y-m-37-07.s.s2.explain: Idan ka saka x = 3/2 = 1.5, to 2·(27/8) − 9/4 − 21/2 + 6 = 0. Ana iya rubuta ma’aunin a matsayin (x − 1)(x + 2)(2x − 3) = 0, saboda haka mafita ukun su ne 1, −2, 3/2. 3/2 ba mai raba 6 ba ne.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta saƙo ga Sua. Ka ɗauka aboki a aji 9 zai karanta. Haɗa dalilin da ya sa ƙarshen Sua ba daidai ba ne, mafitar da ta ɓace, da abin da ya dace a bincika a gaba yayin warware irin wannan matsala.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko amince da mafita biyu da Sua ta riga ta samo, sannan rubuta a jimla ɗaya inda gibin ya fara.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta mafita guda da ta ɓace, sannan ƙara jimla da ke saka ƙimar cikin ma’aunin asali don tabbatarwa.

y-m-37-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na ba Sua abu guda takamaimai da za ta bincika da kanta a gaba?

Idan aka raba da mafita 1, ana samun (x − 1)(2x² + x − 6), wanda ya zama (x − 1)(2x − 3)(x + 2), saboda haka mafitar su ne 1, −2, 3/2.

y-m-37-05.title: Duba ikirarin “idan jadawalin bai haɗu da x-axis ba, to sharadin yana cika kullum”
y-m-37-05.topic: Sharadin da zai sa rashin daidaiton murabba’i ya cika kullum: determinant da ƙididdigar farko
y-m-37-05.goal: Nuna da misalan ƙaryatawa cewa don rashin daidaiton murabba’i ya cika ga duk lambobin gaske, sharadin determinant kaɗai bai isa ba, ana kuma buƙatar alamar ƙididdigar farko; sannan bayyana ma’anar iyakar (D = 0).
y-m-37-05.material: Soyoung ta taƙaita haka: “Ga rashin daidaiton murabba’i ax² + bx + c > 0 (a ≠ 0, a, b, c lambobi ne na gaske), idan determinant D = b² − 4ac ya gaza 0, wannan rashin daidaito yana cika ga duk x na gaske.” (Karanta: a x murabba’i da b x da c sun fi 0.)

y-m-37-05.prereq.1: Jadawalin aikin murabba’i (buɗewa sama/ƙasa) da matsayinsa dangane da x-axis
y-m-37-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncin da ya dace game da taƙaitawar Soyoung.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ko jadawalin y = ax² + 1 yana sama ko ƙasa da x-axis idan a = 1 da kuma idan a = −1.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi (a, b, c) guda mai D < 0, saka x = 0, sannan bincika ko rashin daidaiton ya cika.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.a: Yana daidai kamar yadda yake. Idan D < 0, parabola ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.a: Daidai ne cewa parabola ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis, amma ko yana sama ko ƙasa da x-axis wani al’amari ne daban.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.b: Idan D < 0, ba ya cika ga kowane x.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka tuna misalin a > 0, x² + 1 > 0. D = −4 ne, amma yana cika ga duk x.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.c: Ba za ka iya sanin ko daidai ne ba sai ka saka lambobi cikin a, b, c.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.c: Saka lambobi hanya ce mai kyau, amma idan ka yi tunanin siffar parabola, za ka iya tantancewa ba tare da lambobi ba.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.d: Idan a mara kyau ne, ba ya cika, saboda haka ba daidai ba ne yadda yake.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.explain: Idan D < 0, parabola y = ax² + bx + c ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis. Amma idan a < 0, parabola yana ƙasa da x-axis kawai, saboda haka rashin daidaiton ba ya cika ga kowane x. Misali, −x² − 1 > 0 ba ya cika ga wani x (D = −4 < 0).
y-m-37-05.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri wasu uku-uku na lambobi cikakku biyu (a, b, c) na nau’o’i daban-daban ta yadda determinant D = b² − 4ac ya zama 0 ko ƙasa da haka, amma ax² + bx + c > 0 ba ya cika ga duk x na gaske. Nau’o’in sun bambanta idan alamar a ta bambanta, ko D ya zama 0 ko a’a ya bambanta.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta yadda siffar parabola ta bambanta idan a tabbatacce ne da kuma idan a mara kyau ne, sannan a wurare nawa yake haɗuwa da x-axis idan D = 0.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ga (a, b, c) da ka zaɓa, saka ƙimomi da dama cikin x, nemo x guda da rashin daidaiton bai cika ba, sannan ka tabbatar.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a lamba cikakkiya ce wadda ba 0 ba, b da c ma lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a dole ya zama lamba cikakkiya marar sifili, b da c kuma lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.ok.c2: D ya zama 0 ko ƙasa da haka.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙididdige D = b² − 4ac. Dole ne ya zama 0 ko ƙasa da haka.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Wannan rashin daidaito ba ya cika ga wasu lambobin gaske x.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan a > 0 da D < 0, yana cika ga duk x. Dole ne ka ƙirƙiri misali da x da ba ya cika. Ka yi tunani ko parabola yana buɗewa sama ko ƙasa da matsayinsa dangane da x-axis.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.explain: (−1, 0, −1) yana ba da −x² − 1 > 0, wanda ba ya cika ga kowane x (D = −4, a < 0). (1, 2, 1) yana ba da x² + 2x + 1 = (x + 1)² > 0, wanda yake zama 0 idan x = −1, saboda haka ba ya cika (D = 0, a > 0). (−1, 2, −1) yana ba da −(x − 1)² > 0, wanda ba ya cika ga kowane x (D = 0, a < 0). Akwai nau’o’i daban-daban uku.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta furucin Soyoung don ya zama gaskiya. Ka kuma rubuta tunaninka ko ax² + bx + c > 0 yana cika ga duk lambobin gaske idan D = 0.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta bambancin misalan ƙaryatawa da ka ƙirƙira a baya dangane da alamar a da ƙimar D.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.hint.1: A misali mai D = 0 kamar (1, 2, 1), nemo x da ke sa furucin ya zama 0.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ƙa’idar da na gyara tana cire duk misalan ƙaryatawa da na ƙirƙira a baya?
y-m-37-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na faɗi x ɗin da ƙimar furucin take zama 0 idan D = 0?
y-m-37-05.s.s3.model.0: Yana cika ne kawai idan a > 0 kuma D < 0. Idan D = 0, ƙimar tana 0 idan x = −b/(2a), saboda haka > 0 ba ya cika.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.model.1: Ya isa parabola ya buɗe sama (a tabbatacce ne) kuma determinant ya zama mara kyau. Idan determinant 0 ne, parabola yana taɓa x-axis kuma ƙimarsa 0 ce a wannan wurin, saboda haka ba ya cika kullum.

y-m-37-08.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko jera duk lambobin cikakku da ke cikin −2 < x < 3.
y-m-37-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ka riƙe waɗanda suka cika x > 0 kawai, amma duba ko 0 da kansa yana nan.

y-m-37-08.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin a daban-daban guda uku da za su sa lambobin cikakkiyar x guda 2 su cika rashin daidaiton biyun (adadin goma ma ya dace).
y-m-37-08.s.s2.hint.0: Jera duk lambobin cikakku a −2 < x < 3, kuma yayin da kake canja a, yi alama ɗaya bayan ɗaya kan waɗanda suka cika x > a.
y-m-37-08.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙimar a guda da za ta bar mafitar lambobi cikakku 1 da 2 kawai, sannan ƙara ko rage ta kaɗan don gano inda ƙirga ta canjawa.

y-m-37-08.s.s2.explain: Masu yiwuwa na lambobi cikakku su ne −1, 0, 1, 2. Don 1 da 2 kaɗai su rage suna cika x > a, dole 0 ya fita kuma 1 ya rage, wato 0 ≤ a < 1. Idan a = 0, to x > 0, saboda haka 1 da 2 sun rage, adadinsu 2 ne.
y-m-37-08.s.s3.prompt: Minsu ya amsa cewa kewayon a shi ne 0 < a < 1. Tantance ko amsar daidai ce ta gwada a = 0 da a = 1 da kanka, kuma idan akwai abin gyarawa, sake rubuta ta.
y-m-37-08.s.s3.hint.0: Saka a = 0 da a = 1 dabam cikin x > a, sannan jera lambobin cikakku da suka rage cikin −2 < x < 3.
y-m-37-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta yawan mafitar lambobi cikakku a kowane yanayi da 2.
y-m-37-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Na jera mafitar lambobi cikakku ɗaya bayan ɗaya idan a = 0 da a = 1, sannan na ƙirga su?

y-m-37-08.s.s3.model.0: Idan a = 0, to x > 0, saboda haka akwai mafitar lambobi cikakku biyu, 1 da 2. Saboda haka dole ne a haɗa 0. Idan a = 1, to x > 1, saboda haka mafita guda ɗaya ce, 2, wannan bai dace ba. Don haka 0 ≤ a < 1.
y-m-37-08.s.s3.model.1: Amsar Minsu ta bar 0. Ko a = 0 ne, x > 0 yana nufin 0 ba mafita ba ne, saboda haka mafitar lambobi cikakku su ne 1 da 2, adadinsu biyu ne. Amma idan a = 1, 1 yana fita kuma guda ɗaya ne kawai ya rage. Saboda haka 0 ≤ a < 1 daidai ne.

y-m-37-04.title: Shin ƙimomi kaɗan za su iya gaya mana yawan wuraren haɗuwa?
y-m-37-04.topic: Haɗuwar layi da parabola: gwada wasu ƙimomi kaɗan da ƙarfin hujja
y-m-37-04.goal: Sanin cewa sakamakon gwada wasu ƙimomi kaɗai ba zai tabbatar da cewa “babu irin wannan yanayi” ba, sannan amfani da ma’auni don nemo daidai yanayin taɓawa da bayyana shi.
y-m-37-04.material: Yawan wuraren da layi y = x + k ya haɗu da parabola y = x² yana canjawa bisa k (lamba ta gaske). Hayun ba ta zana jadawalin ba; ta saka ƙimomi cikin k, ta nemo wuraren haɗuwa kai tsaye, ta ƙirƙiri tebur. Yawan wuraren haɗuwa a teburin su ne 0 idan k = −1, 2 idan k = 0, 2 idan k = 1, da 2 idan k = 2 (duk an ƙididdige daidai). Hayun ta ce, “Na bincika dukkan k lambobin cikakku huɗu, saboda haka babu yanayin da layin ya taɓa parabola (ya haɗu da ita a wuri guda).”
y-m-37-04.thinking.0: Tantance yadda hujjar ta goyi bayan ƙarshen
y-m-37-04.thinking.1: Nemo gibin tsakanin ƙimomin da aka gwada
y-m-37-04.thinking.2: Nemo daidai ƙimar sannan ka bayyana
y-m-37-04.prereq.2: Gaskiyar cewa wuraren haɗuwar layi da parabola mafitar ma’aunai masu canji ne
y-m-37-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi tantancewar da ta fi dacewa game da ƙarshen Hayun.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.hint.0: Alama a layin lambobi ƙimomin k da Hayun ta gwada da waɗanda ba ta gwada ba.

y-m-37-04.s.s1.o.a: An ƙididdige teburin daidai gaba ɗaya, saboda haka daidai ne a ce babu yanayin taɓawa.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.r.a: Daidaiton lissafi ya bambanta da wadatar hujja don yanke hukunci. Akwai ƙimomin k da yawa da ba a gwada ba.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.o.b: An bincika ƙimomin k huɗu kawai, saboda haka ba za mu iya tabbatar cewa babu k da layin yake taɓawa ba.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.o.c: Hanya ɗaya tilo ta nemo k da layin yake taɓawa ita ce saka ƙima ɗaya bayan ɗaya, don haka ba za mu iya sani ba.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.r.c: Haka kuma ana iya nemo yawan wuraren haɗuwa ta amfani da determinant na ma’aunin murabba’i. Akwai hanyoyi ban da sakawa.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.o.d: Ya canja daga 0 zuwa 2, saboda haka da alama suna taɓawa a wani k tsakanin −1 da 0.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.r.d: Wannan kyakkyawan hasashe ne da ya yi amfani da wurin da ƙirga ta canja a matsayin alama. Amma tun da hasashe ne, dole ne a tabbatar da shi da ma’auni.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.explain: Binciken lambobin cikakku huɗu bai isa a ce babu k da suke taɓawa ba. Hasashen duba tsakanin −1 da 0, inda haɗuwar ta canja daga 0 zuwa 2, kyakkyawan farawa ne. Amma tun da hasashe ne, dole ne a tabbatar da shi da ma’auni.
y-m-37-04.s.s1.acc.0: Wannan hasashe ne mai ma’ana da ya yi amfani da tazarar da ƙirga ta canja a matsayin alama. Tabbatar da hasashen da ma’auni na zuwa a mataki na gaba.
y-m-37-04.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta a matsayin adadin goma ƙimar k da za ta sa layin y = x + k da parabola y = x² su haɗu a wuri guda tak.
y-m-37-04.s.s2.hint.0: Cire y daga ma’aunai biyu don samun furuci mai x kaɗai.
y-m-37-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta sharadin da zai sa furucin ya sami tushe biyu iri ɗaya, sannan mayar da shi ma’aunin k.
y-m-37-04.s.s2.ok.c1: x² = x + k, wato x² − x − k = 0 yana da tushe biyu iri ɗaya, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a wuri guda.
y-m-37-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Sake tsara x² = x + k a matsayin ma’aunin murabba’i a cikin x, sannan yi amfani da determinant don ƙirga yawan tushen gaske daban-daban.
y-m-37-04.s.s2.explain: Sake tsara x² = x + k yana ba da x² − x − k = 0, determinant ɗinsa 1 + 4k ne. Idan ya zama 0, to k = −1/4, kuma (x − 1/2)² = 0, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a wuri guda x = 1/2. Wannan ƙima tana tsakanin −1 da 0.
y-m-37-04.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta abin da za ka ce wa Hayun. Haɗa dalilin da ya sa gwada lambobin cikakku kaɗan bai isa ba, da yadda ka nemo k da suke taɓawa daidai.
y-m-37-04.s.s3.hint.0: Za ka iya amfani da k ɗin da ka samo a sama yadda yake. Da farko rubuta yawan wuraren haɗuwa a wannan k.
y-m-37-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nuna a jimla guda tazarar k da Hayun ba ta gwada ba.
y-m-37-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Na saka ƙimar k da na rubuta cikin ma’aunai biyun farko, na tabbatar akwai wurin haɗuwa guda ɗaya?
y-m-37-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na bayyana “dalilin da ya sa gwada lambobin cikakku kaɗan bai isa ba” ta yadda Hayun za ta fahimta?
y-m-37-04.s.s3.model.0: Idan ka gwada lambobin cikakku kaɗan kawai, za ka iya rasa k da yake adadin goma. Don x² = x + k, wato x² − x − k = 0, ya sami tushe biyu iri ɗaya, determinant 1 + 4k = 0 dole ne; saboda haka suna taɓawa idan k = −1/4.
y-m-37-04.s.s3.model.1: Hayun ba ta duba tsakanin −1 da 0 ba. Idan ka saka k = −0.25, to x² − x + 0.25 = (x − 0.5)² = 0, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a wuri guda. Kada ka ce babu bayan gwada ƙimomi kaɗan kawai.

y-m-37-09.title: Idan tsawon bango ya canja, shin gadon fure mafi girma ma zai canja?
y-m-37-09.topic: Mafi girman aikin murabba’i da yankin da aka takaita: idan vertex yana wajen kewayon x da aka yarda
y-m-37-09.goal: Sanin cewa ko mafi girman aikin murabba’i yana faruwa a vertex ya dogara ko vertex yana cikin kewayon x da aka yarda, da bambance yanayin da iyaka ba ta canja mafi girman ƙima ba.
y-m-37-09.material: Ana amfani da duk waya shingen mita 24 don kewaye ɓangarori uku kawai na gadon fure mai siffar murabba’i. Ana jingina sauran gefe da bango, ba a sa masa shinge ba. A sa kowane gefen biyu da suka taɓa bango (faɗi) tsawonsa x m ne, gefen da ke gefen bango (tsawo) kuma (24 − 2x) m ne (0 < x < 12). Filin shi ne S = x(24 − 2x) = −2x² + 24x (mita murabba’i). Tsawon ba zai wuce tsawon bangon ba.

y-m-37-02.title: Idan tushe ɗaya 1+2i ne, mene ne ɗayan tushen?
y-m-37-02.topic: Tushen hadaddun lambobi da sharuddan ƙididdigogi: zato da dangantakar tushen da ƙididdigogi take aiki a ƙarƙashinsa
y-m-37-02.goal: Sanin cewa don a ce “ɗayan tushen shi ne hadadden lambar haɗin gwiwa” ga ma’aunin murabba’i mai tushe hadadde da aka bayar, ana buƙatar sharadin ƙididdigogi; sannan ƙirƙiri sauran yiwuwar da kanka idan sharadin babu.
y-m-37-02.material: Ɗaya daga tushen ma’aunin murabba’i x² + px + q = 0 shi ne 1 + 2i. (i alamar adadin zato ce, i² = −1. Karanta: x murabba’i da p x da q daidai yake da 0.) Hyunjun ya ce, “To ɗayan tushen 1 − 2i ne, saboda haka za mu iya nemo p da q.”
y-m-37-02.thinking.0: Tantance wane bayani ya isa ga ƙarshen
y-m-37-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa idan sharadi ya ɓace
y-m-37-02.prereq.1: Ƙari da ninkin lambobi hadadde, da lambobin hadadde masu haɗin gwiwa
y-m-37-02.prereq.2: Dangantakar tushen ma’aunin murabba’i da ƙididdigogi (jimilla da ninkin tushen biyu)
y-m-37-02.s.s1.prompt: Kamar yadda Hyunjun ya ce, don nemo p da q kana buƙatar ƙarin bayani da ba a cikin tambayar ba. Zaɓi duk waɗannan inda ƙara wannan bayani guda ɗaya kaɗai zai ƙayyade p da q kowannensu da ƙima guda.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, kira ɗayan tushen r, ka rubuta sharuddan da 1 + 2i da r dole su cika.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada ko za ka iya ƙirƙirar r biyu daban-daban da suka cika kowane zaɓi. Idan za ka iya, wannan bayanin kaɗai bai isa ba.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.o.a: p lamba cikakkiya ce. Ba a san q ba.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.a: Muddin p lamba cikakkiya ce, ƙimomi da dama suna yiwuwa, kamar p = 0, p = 1, da sauransu. Misali, idan p = 0, ɗayan tushen −1 − 2i ne, wanda ya bambanta da yanayin p = −2.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.o.b: Wannan ma’auni yana da tushe biyu iri ɗaya.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.b: Idan tushe biyu iri ɗaya ne, tushen duka 1 + 2i ne, saboda haka an kuma ƙayyade p da q. Ba damuwa ko ƙididdigogin sun zama lambobi hadadde.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.o.c: p da q duk lambobi ne na gaske.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.c: Idan p da q na gaske ne, ɗayan tushen shi ne lambar hadadde mai haɗin gwiwa, domin sassan zato su soke juna; kuma an ƙayyade p da q.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.o.d: q lamba ce ta gaske. Ba a san p ba.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.d: Sanin q na gaske ne kaɗai ba ya ƙayyade ɗayan tushen. Misali, idan ɗayan tushen 2 − 4i ne, q = 10 lamba ce ta gaske, amma p = −3 + 2i ba na gaske ba ne.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.explain: Idan p da q duk na gaske ne, ɗayan tushen an ƙayyade shi a matsayin 1 − 2i, kuma p = −2, q = 5. Idan tushe biyu iri ɗaya ne, duka tushen 1 + 2i ne, saboda haka p = −2 − 4i da q = −3 + 4i an ƙayyade, amma ƙididdigogin ba na gaske ba ne. Bayanin cewa p lamba cikakkiya ce ko q lamba ce ta gaske ba ya ƙayyade ɗayan tushen guda ɗaya. Za ka iya tantance ko bayanin ya isa ta tambayar “Da gaske akwai ɗayan tushe guda ɗaya ne kawai da ya cika wannan bayanin?”
y-m-37-02.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu a ɗauka p da q lambobi ne na gaske. Zaɓi layin da ba daidai ba a warwarewar da Hyunjun ya nemo p da q.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faɗaɗa x² + px + q = (x − tushe1)(x − tushe2) da kanka, ka rubuta yadda ake bayyana ƙididdigar x da adadin marar canji ta amfani da tushen.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka p da q da ka samu a furucin asali, sa x = 1 + 2i, sannan ka bincika ko ya zama 0. (1 + 2i)² = −3 + 4i.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.line.0: Domin p da q na gaske ne, idan tushe ɗaya 1 + 2i ne, ɗayan tushe shi ne haɗinsa 1 − 2i.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.line.2: Bisa dangantakar tushen da ƙididdigogi, jimillar tushen biyun ita ce p, saboda haka p = 2.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.line.3: Ninkin tushen biyun shi ne (1 + 2i)(1 − 2i) = 1 + 4 = 5, saboda haka q = 5.

y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Kasancewar mafita tana tsakanin tushen biyu yana nufin parabola yana da siffar ∩ (yana buɗewa ƙasa), saboda haka za ka iya sanin alamar a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.d: Ba a ƙayyade ba. a < 0, amma girman sa yana da yiwuwar da dama.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: Tushen biyun −1 da 3 ne kuma mafita tana tsakaninsu, saboda haka a < 0. Yana da sifar a(x + 1)(x − 3) > 0, don haka −x² + 2x + 3 > 0, −2x² + 4x + 6 > 0, ... duk suna yiwuwa, akwai furuci marasa iyaka.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Nemo uku-uku na lambobi cikakku daban-daban guda uku (a, b, c) da ke sa mafitar ax² + bx + c > 0 ta zama daidai −1 < x < 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ma’aunai biyu a cikin a, b, c da ke sa furuci ya zama 0 idan an saka x = −1 da x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da dangantakar b, c da ka samo da a, ƙirƙiri misalai ta canja ƙimar a, sannan bincika alamar a.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙimar furucin idan x = −1 ita ce 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙimar da ake samu idan an saka x = −1 cikin ax² + bx + c dole ta zama 0. Yanzu ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Ƙimar furucin idan x = 3 ita ce 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Ƙimar da ake samu idan an saka x = 3 cikin ax² + bx + c dole ta zama 0. Yanzu ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Siffar tana sa mafita ta kasance tazara tsakanin tushen biyun.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Sake duba alamar a. Don mafita ta kasance tsakanin tushen biyun, wace siffa parabola dole ya kasance da ita?
y-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Duk uku-uku na lambobi cikakku masu b = −2a, c = −3a da a < 0, kamar (−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6), (−3, 6, 9), suna da mafita −1 < x < 3. Furucinsu ninkin juna ne, saboda haka mafitar iri ɗaya ce.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Idan ka ƙara ɗaya daga waɗannan ga bayanin cewa mafita ita ce −1 < x < 3, za a ƙayyade (a, b, c) da amsa guda. Wanne ne?
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ga misalai uku da ka ƙirƙira a baya, bincika ko bayanin kowane zaɓi ya riga ya cika a dukansu.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Idan bayanin ya riga ya cika a kowane misali, ba sabon bayani ba ne. Nemo zaɓin da bai cika ba tukuna.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.a: Idan x = 0, ƙimar ax² + bx + c ita ce 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.b: Matsakaicin axis na aikin murabba’i y = ax² + bx + c shi ne x = 1.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.b: Idan mafita ita ce −1 < x < 3, tsakiyar tushen biyun tuni x = 1 ce. Ka maimaita bayanin da aka riga aka ƙunsa.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.c: Tushen ma’aunin ax² + bx + c = 0 su ne −1 da 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.c: Idan rashin daidaiton yana da mafita −1 < x < 3, tuni za ka iya sanin tushen ma’aunin −1 da 3 ne. Wannan ba sabon bayani ba ne.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.d: a, b, c duk lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.d: Wannan sharadin da aka bayar tuni ne, kuma akwai furuci da dama masu ƙididdigogi cikakku, kamar (−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6).
y-m-37-06.s.s3.explain: Ƙimar idan x = 0 ita ce c. Idan c = 3 ne, daga c = −3a muna samun a = −1, kuma b = 2 an ƙayyade. Sauran zaɓuɓɓukan abubuwa ne da za ka iya riga sani daga mafita −1 < x < 3, don haka ba sabon bayani ba ne. Hanyar gano ko bayani sabo ne: duba ko furuci daban-daban da dama masu cika bayanin har yanzu suna yiwuwa.
